=== about
prepend and append with key and limit together, by selector and by id: the key is applied before the limit.
=== page
<ul id="feed"><li id="a">A</li><li id="b">B</li></ul>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode prepend
data: selector #feed
data: key id
data: limit 2
data: elements <li id="b">B2</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode prepend
data: selector #feed
data: key id
data: limit 2
data: elements <li id="c">C</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: key id
data: limit 2
data: elements <ul id="feed"><li id="d">D</li></ul>

=== dom
<ul id="feed"><li id="a">A</li><li id="d">D</li></ul>
